---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or new check for lockstep
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Problem**

What toolchain-drift or workflow pain are you hitting? Describe the declaration
source that lockstep does not currently read, or the conflict it fails to
report. Name the files and version fields involved where you can.

**Proposed solution**

What you would like lockstep to do. If you are proposing a new rule, sketch the
check and the failure it should report; if it touches an existing source parser,
describe the file format and the versions it declares.

**Alternatives**

Any workarounds you use today, and why they are not good enough.
